name: opening_range_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
thesis: The first 15-minute range captures the initial price discovery as overnight information gets priced in. A breakout above/below this range with volume confirmation signals directional intent for the session. The inefficiency exists because the opening range aggregates heterogeneous information (global cues, pre-market orders, institutional positioning) and the breakout direction often persists due to momentum cascades. Hasn't been arbitraged away because the optimal parameters (range window, confirmation method) vary by stock and regime, requiring continuous calibration.
stock_filter: top 20 by avg daily turnover, avg daily range > 1.2%

conditions: orb_range > 0.003 * orb_midpoint (range is at least 30 bps — not too tight)
orb_range < 0.5 * atr_20_daily (range is not too wide — room to run)
long.confirmation: bar closes above orb_high with volume > SMA(volume, 10)

short.confirmation: bar closes below orb_low with volume > SMA(volume, 10)

exit.trailing_stop: move SL to breakeven after +0.4%, then trail by 0.3%
exit.time_stop: exit by 14:30 if target not reached
exit.signal_exit: close crosses back inside ORB range

risk.position_sizing: vol_adjusted — reduce size if atr_20_daily is above median

filters.trend_filter: for long: nifty_50 return from open > 0; for short: < 0
filters.event_filter: skip on budget day, RBI policy day (ORB is unreliable on massive gap days)
other_filters: skip if ORB range < 30 bps (too tight, noise) or > 50% of daily ATR (too wide, no room)

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — well-known strategy but execution details vary widely

weaknesses: False breakouts are the #1 failure mode — price pokes above ORB high then reverses
Low win rate (48%) requires discipline; 5-6 consecutive losers are normal
On flat/range-bound days, ORB breakouts fail repeatedly — need regime filter
prior_art: Opening Range Breakout (Toby Crabel). One of the most studied intraday strategies.
notes: Test 5-min, 15-min, and 30-min ORB windows. 15-min is the default but 30-min may be more reliable in India due to volatile opens.
